items.title: US envoy Witkoff meets with Putin in effort to advance proposals to end war in Ukraine
items.brief: US special envoy Steve Witkoff held talks on Wednesday with Russian President Vladimir Putin aimed at advancing proposals to end to the war in Ukraine and create a pathway to broader negotiations .

items.title: The iPhone Duo is Apple’s coolest phone in years. There’s just one problem
items.brief: There were many times I didn’t want to put the iPhone Duo down.

items.title: North Korea tells border troops to take ‘resolute action’ if South threatens their safety
items.brief: North Korea has told its border troops to take “prompt ​and resolute action” if South Korean forces threaten their safety, state media ​said on Wednesday, raising the risk of a clash along the ⁠heavily armed frontier.

items.title: Russia frees 74-year-old American Stephen Hubbard captured in occupied Ukraine
items.brief: Russia has freed an American imprisoned in Russia for more than four years on charges of fighting as a mercenary in Ukraine, with US President Donald Trump saying he is “on his way back home.”

items.title: What DC loses if it loses a major park to Trump’s golf dream
items.brief: President Donald Trump’s plans to tear up East Potomac Golf Links and the surrounding park are far more than just the latest obsession of a chief executive looking to put his mark on the nation’s capital.

items.title: UK approves new gas field in the North Sea amid rising concerns about energy security
items.brief: The UK government has approved the development of a major new gas field in the North Sea that could begin production as soon as this month, as the war in the Middle East deepens concerns about energy security globally.

items.title: How to catch a glimpse of the dazzling Orionid meteor shower
items.brief: The Orionid meteor shower creates one of the most brilliant displays in the night sky each fall — but this year’s celestial event may have a dimmer showing due to a bright moon.

items.title: Vivek Ramaswamy’s attack ad featuring Amy Acton’s estranged mother roils Ohio’s governor race
items.brief: The campaign of Ohio Republican governor nominee Vivek Ramaswamy said it would launch a $4 million ad campaign featuring a controversial video of his Democratic opponent’s estranged mom after it went viral online.
